entries.notes: H1.4 (QEMU -cpu cortex-a72) and H1.3 reach it. Run 2026-10-04 under QEMU, which executes a core without DotProd for real (a forced tag on DotProd hardware cannot reach a test that calls an SDOT kernel directly); goinfer's decoder suite is far too slow under emulation (6 tests in 10 minutes), so goinfer runs the kernels through the forced-tag CI job instead, which cannot reach an unguarded DotProd instruction outside the dispatched kernels. H1.4 is done as that job; a QEMU leg for aikit's linalg in aikit's CI is the unbuilt remainder.
